query:
SELECT
                    check_run.id,
                    check_run.github_id,
                    check_run.name,
                    check_run.status as "status: WorkflowStatus",
                    check_run.url,
                    check_run.started_at as "started_at: DateTime<Utc>",
                    (
                        build.id,
                        build.repository,
                        build.branch,
                        build.commit_sha,
                        build.status,
                        build.parent,
                        build.created_at,
                        build.check_run_id,
                        build.kind,
                        build.duration
                    ) as "build!: BuildModel"
                FROM check_run
                    LEFT JOIN build on check_run.build_id = build.id
                WHERE build.id = $1
